name: Hitokata Mai
source:
[url=/c24797]Yuu's[/url] classmate and one of the bride candidates.
She has a bright and carefree personality, and she treats transfer student Yuu kindly.
She loves martial arts, especially professional wrestling. She is the chairman and only member of the professional wrestling club that she hosts.

[Partially translated from the game's [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/josou/index.html]official homepage[/url].]
translation:
[url=/c24797]Yuu's[/url] classmate and one of the bride candidates.
She has a bright and carefree personality, and she treats transfer student Yuu kindly.
She loves martial arts, especially professional wrestling. She is the chairman and only member of the professional wrestling club that she hosts.

[Partially translated from the game's [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/josou/index.html]official homepage[/url].]
